content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","confidence":"high","explanation":"The morning TV spot for the zero-balance savings account (MKT-2026-237) aired at 10:50 to an audience of 2,000,000, with the phone number on screen. Calls to general jumped from 11:15: 122 and 124 calls against forecasts of about 80 (+53% and +57%), and service level fell to 19.7% and then 4.8%, with 48 calls abandoned. Over the last hour, new_offer_enquiry calls reached 72 against 19.4 expected (3.7x normal), far above every other reason. Staffing is 35 against 37 planned, absences are close to normal (3 vs 2.5 usual) and handle time is on forecast, so the problem is extra demand, not a shortage of agents.","evidence":[{"source":"calendar","ref_id":"MKT-2026-237","summary":"TV spot for the zero-balance savings account aired 10:50 to 2,000,000 viewers, with the number on screen; the call spike started in the 11:15 interval."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"new_offer_enquiry","summary":"72 calls vs 19.4 expected (3.71x), share 16.6% vs 6.0% normal; 52.6 excess calls, the largest of any reason."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"volume","summary":"11:15: 122 calls vs 79.9 forecast (+52.7%); 11:30: 124 vs 78.9 (+57.1%)."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"service_level","summary":"Fell to 19.7% at 11:15 and 4.8% at 11:30, with 23 and 25 calls abandoned."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"aht","summary":"Handle time is on forecast during the spike (367.8s vs 380.9s, then 353.9s vs 367.6s), so slow systems are not the cause."},{"source":"attendance","ref_id":"attendance_log","summary":"General has 3 sick absences vs 2.5 usual, which is normal; agents on phones are 35 vs 37 planned."}],"flagged_injections":[]}
